metadata.title: SohappyPDF
metadata.description: Convert PDFs and images with a simple workflow and a public API.

hero.title: PDF tools that stay simple for people and APIs.
hero.description: Open a tool, upload a file, process it, and download the result. No account required for basic use.

demo.title: From upload to download
demo.description: Each tool owns its workflow: select a file, process it, then download the temporary result.

features.title: What you can do today
features.description: SohappyPDF processes supported files in the cloud and keeps temporary results available for about two hours.

conversion.title: PDF tools
conversion.description: Merge, split, compress, convert, protect, and more from focused tool pages.

workflow.title: Simple tool workflow
workflow.description: Upload on the tool page, process, and download when the result is ready.

history.title: Recent activity
history.description: Signed-in accounts can review recent executions. Files remain temporary.

api.title: Developer API
api.description: Call the same file and processing workflow with an API key.

keys.title: API keys
keys.description: Create and revoke keys in your account. The raw key is shown only once.

limits.title: Predictable limits
limits.description: Free and Pro plans publish credits, file size, and API limits.

security.title: Private files
security.description: Files belong to your anonymous session or account. Downloads use short-lived signed access.

cloud.title: Cloud processing
cloud.description: Jobs run in the cloud, so you do not install conversion software locally.

upload.title: Upload
upload.description: Open a tool and send a supported file.

convert.title: Process
convert.description: Choose options if needed. Processing continues in the background.

download.title: Download
download.description: Download the result when processing completes. Temporary files expire after about two hours.

developer.title: An API for the same product
developer.description: Create an API key, authenticate with a Bearer token, then upload, convert, and download through the public v1 API.

security.title: Security properties we actually provide
security.description: These are product controls, not third-party compliance certifications.

authentication.title: Secure authentication
authentication.description: The dashboard uses email and password authentication before account data is shown.

privateFiles.title: Private files
privateFiles.description: Uploaded and converted files are scoped to the signed-in account or API key owner.

authorization.title: Server-side authorization
authorization.description: File, conversion, and API key actions are authorized on the server.

signedAccess.title: Signed result access
signedAccess.description: Downloads are issued as short-lived signed URLs rather than public object links.

apiKeys.title: API key protection
apiKeys.description: Keys are secrets. Revoke a leaked key in the dashboard and create a replacement.

pricing.title: Free and Pro plans
pricing.description: Limits come from the same plan catalog the product enforces.
pricing.note: Pro upgrades use the existing Polar checkout after you sign in. This page does not invent a price.

free.name: Free
free.summary: Start converting with a monthly allowance.

pro.name: Pro
pro.summary: More web credits, larger files, and higher API capacity.

toolsDirectory.title: PDF tools
toolsDirectory.description: Every public tool is a focused workflow. Pick a category, open a tool, upload a file, and download the result.

categories.organize: Combine, split, and rearrange PDF pages.

categories.edit: Add watermarks, page numbers, and light edits.

categories.document: Convert Office files and images to PDF.
categories.intelligence: OCR, summarize, and translate document content.

how.question: How do I use this tool?
how.answer: Upload a supported file, start processing, then download the result when it is ready. An account is not required unless the tool says it is.

account.question: Do I need an account?
